amc8-1985-q1.summary: Evaluate $\dfrac{3\cdot5}{9\cdot11}\cdot\dfrac{7\cdot9\cdot11}{3\cdot5\cdot7}$. Options: A $1$, B $0$, C $49$, D $1/49$, E $50$.

methods.title: Cancel common factors
steps: Combine the factors into one fraction. Its numerator and denominator both contain exactly the factors $3,5,7,9,11$.
Cancel every matching factor; the quotient is $1$.
stepsZh: 把两个分数合并，分子和分母都恰好含有因数 $3,5,7,9,11$。
逐一约去相同因数，结果为 $1$。

methods.title: Pair the endpoints
steps: There are ten terms. Pair the smallest with the largest: each of the five pairs has sum $90+99=189$.
Therefore the total is $5\cdot189=945$.
stepsZh: 共有十项，首尾依次配对得到五对，每对的和都是 $90+99=189$。
所以总和为 $5\cdot189=945$。

methods.title: Subtract exponents
steps: First divide the powers of ten: $10^7/10^4=10^3=1000$.

amc8-1985-q4.summary: A rectilinear polygon is obtained from a $6$-by-$9$ rectangle by removing the lower-left rectangular corner. The remaining left vertical side is $5$, and the remaining bottom horizontal side is $4$. Find its area. Options: A $24$, B $30$, C $46$, D $66$, E $74$.
amc8-1985-q4.summaryZh: 从一个 $6\times9$ 的长方形左下角挖去一个小长方形，所得直角折线多边形的左侧剩余竖边长为 $5$，底部剩余横边长为 $4$。求多边形面积。选项为 A $24$，B $30$，C $46$，D $66$，E $74$。

methods.title: Subtract the missing corner
steps: The full rectangle has area $6\cdot9=54$.
The removed corner has width $6-4=2$ and height $9-5=4$, so its area is $2\cdot4=8$.
The required area is $54-8=46$.
stepsZh: 完整长方形面积为 $6\cdot9=54$。

amc8-1985-q5.summary: A grade bar chart records $5,4,3,3,5$ students receiving grades A, B, C, D, F, respectively. If A through D are satisfactory, what fraction of the displayed grades are satisfactory? Options: A $1/2$, B $2/3$, C $3/4$, D $4/5$, E $9/10$.
amc8-1985-q5.summaryZh: 某成绩条形图中，获得 A、B、C、D、F 的人数依次为 $5,4,3,3,5$。若 A 至 D 均为合格成绩，图中合格成绩所占比例是多少？选项为 A $1/2$，B $2/3$，C $3/4$，D $4/5$，E $9/10$。

methods.title: Read and total the bars
steps: The satisfactory grades total $5+4+3+3=15$ students.
All five bars total $15+5=20$ students, so the fraction is $15/20=3/4$.

amc8-1985-q6.summary: A stack of $500$ identical sheets is $5$ cm thick. Approximately how many sheets are in a $7.5$ cm stack? Options: A $250$, B $550$, C $667$, D $750$, E $1250$.
amc8-1985-q6.summaryZh: $500$ 张相同的纸叠起来厚 $5$ cm。厚 $7.5$ cm 的同种纸约有多少张？选项为 A $250$，B $550$，C $667$，D $750$，E $1250$。

methods.title: Use a unit rate
steps: The stack contains $500/5=100$ sheets per centimetre.
Thus $7.5$ cm contains $100\cdot7.5=750$ sheets.
stepsZh: 每厘米厚度对应 $500/5=100$ 张纸。

amc8-1985-q7.summary: A stair-step pattern has row $n$ made of $n$ white squares separated by black squares, beginning and ending with white. How many black squares are in row $37$? Options: A $34$, B $35$, C $36$, D $37$, E $38$.
amc8-1985-q7.summaryZh: 阶梯图案的第 $n$ 行含 $n$ 个白色方格，白格之间各放一个黑格，并且每行都以白格开始和结束。第 $37$ 行有多少个黑格？选项为 A $34$，B $35$，C $36$，D $37$，E $38$。

methods.title: Count gaps between white squares
steps: A row with $n$ white squares has exactly $n-1$ gaps between consecutive white squares.
Each gap contains one black square, so row $37$ has $37-1=36$ black squares.
stepsZh: 一行有 $n$ 个白格时，相邻白格之间恰有 $n-1$ 个间隔。
每个间隔放一个黑格，因此第 $37$ 行有 $37-1=36$ 个黑格。

amc8-1985-q8.summary: For $a=-2$, determine the largest member of $\{-3a,4a,24/a,a^2,1\}$. Options A through E list these five expressions in that order.
amc8-1985-q8.summaryZh: 当 $a=-2$ 时，求集合 $\{-3a,4a,24/a,a^2,1\}$ 中的最大数。A 至 E 依次对应上述五个式子。

methods.title: Substitute and compare
steps: Substitution gives $-3a=6$, $4a=-8$, $24/a=-12$, $a^2=4$, and $1$.
The greatest value is $6$, supplied by $-3a$.
stepsZh: 其中最大值是 $6$，对应 $-3a$。

methods.title: Telescope the product
steps: Rewrite each factor as $1-1/k=(k-1)/k$. The product becomes $(1/2)(2/3)(3/4)\cdots(9/10)$.
Every interior numerator cancels the preceding denominator, leaving $1/10$.
stepsZh: 中间因子全部相消，只剩 $1/10$。

amc8-1985-q10.summary: Find the fraction halfway between $1/5$ and $1/3$ on the number line. Options: A $1/4$, B $2/15$, C $4/15$, D $53/200$, E $8/15$.

methods.title: Average the endpoints
steps: The midpoint is the average: $\frac12(1/5+1/3)$.
Using denominator $15$ gives $\frac12(3/15+5/15)=\frac12(8/15)=4/15$.
stepsZh: 中点等于两端点的平均数，即 $\frac12(1/5+1/3)$。

amc8-1985-q11.summary: A cube net has three squares $U,V,W$ in a horizontal row. Square $X$ is directly below $V$, $Z$ is directly below $X$, and $Y$ is directly above $W$. After folding, which face is opposite $X$? Options: A $Z$, B $U$, C $V$, D $W$, E $Y$.
amc8-1985-q11.summaryZh: 一个正方体展开图中，$U,V,W$ 三格从左到右排成一行；$X$ 在 $V$ 的正下方，$Z$ 在 $X$ 的正下方，$Y$ 在 $W$ 的正上方。折成立方体后，与 $X$ 相对的是哪一面？选项为 A $Z$，B $U$，C $V$，D $W$，E $Y$。

methods.title: Fold around face V
methods.titleZh: 以 V 面为中心折叠
steps: Take $V$ as the front face. Then $U$ and $W$ fold to the left and right, while $X$ folds to the bottom and $Z$ wraps to the back.
Because $Y$ is attached above the right face $W$, it folds to the top. Hence $Y$ is opposite the bottom face $X$.
stepsZh: 把 $V$ 作为正面，则 $U,W$ 分别折成左、右面，$X$ 折成底面，$Z$ 绕到底面的后方成为背面。
$Y$ 连接在右面 $W$ 的上方，折叠后成为顶面，所以 $Y$ 与底面 $X$ 相对。

amc8-1985-q12.summary: A square and a triangle have equal perimeters. The triangle sides are $6.2$, $8.3$, and $9.5$ cm. Find the square's area. Options: A $24$, B $36$, C $48$, D $64$, E $144$ square centimetres.
amc8-1985-q12.summaryZh: 一个正方形与一个三角形周长相等。三角形三边分别为 $6.2$、$8.3$、$9.5$ cm。求正方形面积。选项为 A $24$，B $36$，C $48$，D $64$，E $144$ 平方厘米。

methods.title: Convert perimeter to side length
steps: The triangle perimeter is $6.2+8.3+9.5=24$ cm, so the square also has perimeter $24$ cm.
Its side is $24/4=6$ cm and its area is $6^2=36$ square centimetres.
stepsZh: 三角形周长为 $6.2+8.3+9.5=24$ cm，因此正方形周长也是 $24$ cm。
正方形边长为 $24/4=6$ cm，面积为 $6^2=36$ 平方厘米。

amc8-1985-q13.summary: Walk for $45$ minutes at $4$ mph, then run for $30$ minutes at $10$ mph. Find the total distance. Options: A $3.5$, B $8$, C $9$, D $25\frac13$, E $480$ miles.
amc8-1985-q13.summaryZh: 先以每小时 $4$ 英里步行 $45$ 分钟，再以每小时 $10$ 英里跑步 $30$ 分钟。求总路程。选项为 A $3.5$，B $8$，C $9$，D $25\frac13$，E $480$ 英里。

methods.title: Add the two travel legs
steps: Convert times to hours: $45$ minutes is $3/4$ hour and $30$ minutes is $1/2$ hour.
The distances are $4\cdot3/4=3$ miles and $10\cdot1/2=5$ miles, totaling $8$ miles.
stepsZh: 先把时间化为小时：$45$ 分钟是 $3/4$ 小时，$30$ 分钟是 $1/2$ 小时。
两段路程分别为 $4\cdot3/4=3$ 英里和 $10\cdot1/2=5$ 英里，总计 $8$ 英里。

amc8-1985-q14.summary: Find the difference between a $6.5\%$ sales tax and a $6\%$ sales tax on a 20-dollar item. Options: A $0.01$, B $0.10$, C $0.50$, D $1$, E $10$ dollars.
amc8-1985-q14.summaryZh: 一件税前价格为 $20$ 美元的商品，按 $6.5\%$ 与按 $6\%$ 计算的销售税相差多少？选项为 A $0.01$，B $0.10$，C $0.50$，D $1$，E $10$ 美元。

methods.title: Apply the rate difference
steps: The tax rates differ by $6.5\%-6\%=0.5\%=0.005$.
Applying that difference to $20$ dollars gives $0.005\cdot20=0.10$ dollar.

amc8-1985-q15.summary: How many whole numbers from $100$ through $399$ contain at least one digit $2$? Options: A $100$, B $120$, C $138$, D $140$, E $148$.

methods.title: Count the complement
steps: There are $300$ integers from $100$ through $399$.
To avoid digit $2$, the hundreds digit has $2$ choices ($1$ or $3$), and each other digit has $9$ choices. Thus $2\cdot9\cdot9=162$ numbers contain no $2$.
Therefore $300-162=138$ numbers contain at least one $2$.
stepsZh: 若不含数字 $2$，百位只能取 $1$ 或 $3$，十位和个位各有 $9$ 种选择，共 $2\cdot9\cdot9=162$ 个。

amc8-1985-q16.summary: The ratio of boys to girls in a class is $2:3$, and the class has $30$ students. How many more girls than boys are there? Options: A $10$, B $5$, C $3$, D $6$, E $2$.
amc8-1985-q16.summaryZh: 班级中男生与女生人数之比为 $2:3$，全班共有 $30$ 人。女生比男生多多少人？选项为 A $10$，B $5$，C $3$，D $6$，E $2$。

methods.title: Scale the ratio parts
steps: The ratio has $2+3=5$ equal parts, so one part represents $30/5=6$ students.
Girls exceed boys by $3-2=1$ part, or $6$ students.
stepsZh: 女生比男生多 $3-2=1$ 份，即 $6$ 人。

amc8-1985-q17.summary: The mean of the first six test scores is $84$, while the mean of the first seven is $85$. Find the seventh score. Options: A $86$, B $88$, C $90$, D $91$, E $92$.
amc8-1985-q17.summaryZh: 前六次数学测验的平均分是 $84$，前七次的平均分是 $85$。求第七次成绩。选项为 A $86$，B $88$，C $90$，D $91$，E $92$。

methods.title: Subtract the running totals
steps: The first seven scores total $7\cdot85=595$, while the first six total $6\cdot84=504$.
The seventh score is their difference, $595-504=91$.
stepsZh: 前七次总分为 $7\cdot85=595$，前六次总分为 $6\cdot84=504$。
第七次成绩为两者之差 $595-504=91$。

amc8-1985-q18.summary: Nine copies of a pamphlet cost less than 10 dollars, but ten copies at the same unit price cost more than 11 dollars. Which listed unit price is possible? Options: A $1.07$, B $1.08$, C $1.09$, D $1.10$, E $1.11$ dollars.
amc8-1985-q18.summaryZh: 同一种小册子买九本总价低于 $10$ 美元，买十本总价高于 $11$ 美元。单价可能是哪一个？选项为 A $1.07$，B $1.08$，C $1.09$，D $1.10$，E $1.11$ 美元。

methods.title: Intersect the two price bounds
steps: If the unit price is $p$, then $9p<10$ and $10p>11$. Hence $1.10<p<10/9\approx1.111\ldots$.
Among the choices only $1.11$ lies in this interval. Indeed, $9(1.11)=9.99<10$ and $10(1.11)=11.10>11$.

amc8-1985-q19.summary: Both the length and width of a rectangle increase by $10\%$. By what percent does its perimeter increase? Options: A $1\%$, B $10\%$, C $20\%$, D $21\%$, E $40\%$.
amc8-1985-q19.summaryZh: 一个长方形的长和宽都增加 $10\%$。它的周长增加百分之多少？选项为 A $1\%$，B $10\%$，C $20\%$，D $21\%$，E $40\%$。

methods.title: Factor out the scale factor
steps: The old perimeter is $2(L+W)$. The new perimeter is $2(1.1L+1.1W)=1.1\cdot2(L+W)$.
Thus the perimeter is multiplied by $1.1$, an increase of $10\%$.
stepsZh: 所以周长变为原来的 $1.1$ 倍，即增加 $10\%$。

methods.title: Check with a convenient rectangle
steps: For a $10$-by-$20$ rectangle the perimeter is $60$. After the increase it is $11$ by $22$, with perimeter $66$.
Since $66/60=1.1$, the increase is $10\%$.
stepsZh: 取长宽为 $10,20$ 的长方形，周长为 $60$；增加后长宽为 $11,22$，周长为 $66$。

amc8-1985-q20.summary: In one year, January contained exactly four Tuesdays and four Saturdays. On which weekday did January 1 fall? Options: A Monday, B Tuesday, C Wednesday, D Friday, E Saturday.
amc8-1985-q20.summaryZh: 某年的一月份恰有四个星期二和四个星期六。该年 $1$ 月 $1$ 日是星期几？选项为 A 星期一，B 星期二，C 星期三，D 星期五，E 星期六。

methods.title: Identify the three extra weekdays
methods.titleZh: 确定三个多出现一次的星期
steps: January has $31=4\cdot7+3$ days. Every weekday occurs four times, and the weekdays of January 1, 2, and 3 occur once more.
Tuesday and Saturday must not be among those three consecutive extra weekdays. A Wednesday start makes the extras Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, missing both.
Therefore January 1 was Wednesday.
stepsZh: 一月有 $31=4\cdot7+3$ 天，每个星期至少出现四次，而 $1,2,3$ 日对应的三个星期会多出现一次。
星期二和星期六都不能在这三个连续的星期中。从星期三开始时，多出的三个星期是星期三、四、五，恰好避开二者。
所以 $1$ 月 $1$ 日是星期三。

amc8-1985-q21.summary: A salary receives a $10\%$ raise in each of four successive years. Which interval contains the total percentage increase? Options: A less than $40\%$, B exactly $40\%$, C $44\%$, D $45\%$, E more than $45\%$.
amc8-1985-q21.summaryZh: 某人的工资连续四年每年上涨 $10\%$。四次上涨后的总涨幅属于哪一种？选项为 A 小于 $40\%$，B 恰为 $40\%$，C $44\%$，D $45\%$，E 大于 $45\%$。

methods.title: Compound the four raises
steps: Each raise multiplies the salary by $1.1$, so four raises multiply it by $1.1^4$.
Now $1.1^4=1.4641$, corresponding to a $46.41\%$ increase, which is more than $45\%$.
stepsZh: 每次加薪都把工资乘以 $1.1$，四次后倍数为 $1.1^4$。

amc8-1985-q22.summary: Every seven-digit string is an allowed telephone number except those beginning with $0$ or $1$. What fraction of allowed numbers begin with $9$ and end with $0$? Options: A $1/63$, B $1/80$, C $1/81$, D $1/90$, E $1/100$.
amc8-1985-q22.summaryZh: 除首位为 $0$ 或 $1$ 的情形外，每个七位数字串都可作为电话号码。合法号码中，以 $9$ 开头且以 $0$ 结尾的比例是多少？选项为 A $1/63$，B $1/80$，C $1/81$，D $1/90$，E $1/100$。

methods.title: Count favourable and total numbers
methods.titleZh: 分别计算有利情形与总数
steps: The first digit has $8$ choices ($2$ through $9$), and the other six have $10$ each, so there are $8\cdot10^6$ allowed numbers.
For a number starting with $9$ and ending with $0$, the five middle digits are free, giving $10^5$ numbers.
The desired fraction is $10^5/(8\cdot10^6)=1/80$.
stepsZh: 首位有 $8$ 种选择（$2$ 至 $9$），其余六位各有 $10$ 种，因此合法号码共有 $8\cdot10^6$ 个。
首位固定为 $9$、末位固定为 $0$ 时，中间五位任取，共 $10^5$ 个。

amc8-1985-q23.summary: A school has $1200$ students. Each student attends $5$ classes daily; each class has $30$ students and one teacher; each teacher teaches $4$ classes. How many teachers are there? Options: A $30$, B $32$, C $40$, D $45$, E $50$.
amc8-1985-q23.summaryZh: 某校有 $1200$ 名学生，每人每天上 $5$ 节课；每班有 $30$ 名学生和一位教师；每位教师每天教 $4$ 节课。学校有多少位教师？选项为 A $30$，B $32$，C $40$，D $45$，E $50$。

methods.title: Double-count class enrolments
steps: Students generate $1200\cdot5=6000$ student-class enrolments. With $30$ students per class, the school runs $6000/30=200$ classes.
Each teacher covers $4$ classes, so the number of teachers is $200/4=50$.
stepsZh: 学生一共形成 $1200\cdot5=6000$ 个上课人次。每班 $30$ 人，因此共有 $6000/30=200$ 个班次。
每位教师承担 $4$ 个班次，所以教师人数为 $200/4=50$。

amc8-1985-q24.summary: Place the integers $10,11,12,13,14,15$ in six circles on the boundary of a triangle: one at each vertex and one at the midpoint of each side. The three numbers on every side must have the same sum $S$. Find the greatest possible $S$. Options: A $36$, B $37$, C $38$, D $39$, E $40$.
amc8-1985-q24.summaryZh: 把整数 $10,11,12,13,14,15$ 分别放入三角形边界上的六个圆：三个顶点各一个，每条边中点各一个。要求每条边上的三个数之和都等于 $S$。求 $S$ 的最大可能值。选项为 A $36$，B $37$，C $38$，D $39$，E $40$。

methods.title: Double-count the vertices
steps: All six integers sum to $75$. Adding the three side sums counts every number once and each vertex once more, so $3S=75+$ (sum of the three vertices).
To maximise $S$, use $13,14,15$ at the vertices. Their sum is $42$, hence $3S=117$ and $S=39$.
This is attainable: the vertex-pair sums are $27,28,29$, and the remaining middle values $12,11,10$ complete each side to $39$.
stepsZh: 六个整数总和为 $75$。把三条边的和相加时，每个数至少计算一次，三个顶点又各多算一次，所以 $3S=75+$（三个顶点之和）。
该值可以达到：三组顶点对之和为 $27,28,29$，把剩余的 $12,11,10$ 分别放在相应边中点即可使每边和为 $39$。

amc8-1985-q25.summary: Five cards show $P,Q,3,4,6$. Each card has a letter on one face and a whole number on the other. Jane claims: if a card has a vowel on one face, then it has an even number on the other. Mary disproves the claim by turning over one card. Which visible card must she turn? Options: A $3$, B $4$, C $6$, D $P$, E $Q$.
amc8-1985-q25.summaryZh: 桌上五张卡片朝上的一面分别是 $P,Q,3,4,6$，每张卡一面是字母，另一面是整数。Jane 声称：若一面是元音字母，则另一面一定是偶数。Mary 只翻一张卡就推翻了该说法。她翻的是哪张？选项为 A $3$，B $4$，C $6$，D $P$，E $Q$。

methods.title: Look for a counterexample
steps: The rule fails only if one card pairs a vowel with an odd number.
Turning $P$ or $Q$ cannot test a vowel, and turning $4$ or $6$ cannot expose an odd number. Only the card showing odd number $3$ can have a hidden vowel and contradict the rule.
Therefore Mary turned over the card showing $3$.
stepsZh: 要推翻命题，必须找到一张“元音字母—奇数”的卡片。
翻 $P$ 或 $Q$ 不能检验元音条件，翻 $4$ 或 $6$ 也不可能暴露奇数；只有正面为奇数 $3$ 的卡片，背面若是元音就能形成反例。
所以 Mary 翻的是数字 $3$ 卡片。
